diagnosticPresets.title: Red LOS Light Blinking
diagnosticPresets.subtitle: Optical Fiber Cut / Zero Signal
diagnosticPresets.tip: Check if the yellow/white fiber patch cord behind your ONT router is unplugged or sharply bent. If intact, an outdoor fiber splice team is dispatched immediately.

diagnosticPresets.title: Slow Speed / High Ping
diagnosticPresets.subtitle: Bandwidth Drop or Latency Spike
diagnosticPresets.tip: Our NOC checks your optical Rx power (-15 to -24 dBm ideal) and resets your PPPoE bandwidth profile on the Core BRAS.

diagnosticPresets.title: Frequent Disconnection
diagnosticPresets.subtitle: Link Drops Every Few Minutes
diagnosticPresets.tip: Usually caused by high optical attenuation (> -27 dBm) or loose SC/APC connector. Our field lineman re-terminates the connector.

diagnosticPresets.title: Router / ONT Hardware Fault
diagnosticPresets.subtitle: Power Adapter or Wi-Fi Issue
diagnosticPresets.tip: If your router power LED is off or PON light fails to register, our field team tests the 12V power unit and optical transceiver.

faqs.q: What is our official Licensed Coverage Area?
faqs.a: We operate licensed PTA CVAS Optical Fiber FTTH broadband across our designated district sectors with 24/7 local splicing and NOC support.

faqs.q: How can I contact the 24/7 NOC Helpline & Support?
faqs.a: You can call or WhatsApp our 24/7 NOC Helpline & support number or email our support desk anytime for immediate assistance.

faqs.q: Is my complaint history private when I sign in with Gmail?
faqs.a: Yes! Your Gmail account is strictly isolated. Customers can only see their own complaint status and nothing else.

tickets.subject: Complete Media Outage - Underground Fiber Cut near Jaranwala Road
tickets.description: Corporate leased line disconnected since 02:30 PM. Optical red light LOS blinking on Huawei ONT. Critical export dispatch halted.
tickets.rootCauseNotes: WASA construction excavator snagged 48-core backbone optical cable near Canal Pull.
tickets.correctiveAction: Splicing crew on site with Fujikura fusion splicer. 36 cores restored; remaining 12 in progress.

timeline.notes: Priority P1 Critical assigned automatically based on Dedicated CIR & Complete Outage
Dispatched emergency van with OTDR and spare 48-core armored patch
Cut point located at 3.4km from OLT rack. Excavation pit cleared.

tickets.subject: High Latency & Speed Capped at 4 Mbps during peak hours
tickets.description: Subscribed to 50 Mbps package but getting only 3.8 Mbps on fast.com and speedtest. High jitter during online video meetings.
tickets.rootCauseCategory: PON Port Saturated / Bandwidth Profile Glitch
tickets.rootCauseNotes: Customer PPPoE session had stale QoS rate-limit rule from previous month billing cycle.
tickets.correctiveAction: Reprovisioned PPPoE profile on MikroTik CCR2004 Core BRAS. Verified throughput at 51.4 Mbps.
tickets.feedbackComments: Speed is fully restored back to 50 Mbps. Thank you for prompt resolution.

timeline.notes: Confirmed speed test 51.2 Mbps downlink / 50.8 Mbps uplink.

tickets.subject: Internet Drops Every 15 Minutes - High Optical Attenuation
tickets.description: ONU LOS light flickers red intermittently. Fiber drop cable bent during wall paint work in the house.
tickets.rootCauseCategory: Damaged Indoor Drop Cable / Tight Bend
tickets.rootCauseNotes: Indoor single-mode drop fiber had sharp 90-degree kink behind wooden cupboard causing high macro-bending loss.
tickets.correctiveAction: Re-pulled 15 meters G.657 bend-insensitive drop wire and respliced SC/APC mechanical connector. Power improved to -19.2 dBm.
tickets.feedbackComments: Technician Kamran visited and replaced the damaged cable within 5 hours. Very satisfied.

tickets.subject: Advance Billing Invoice Discrepancy & Sales Tax Deduction
tickets.description: Billed Rs. 3,500 instead of agreed promotion price Rs. 3,000 for October. 19.5% PRA Punjab Sales Tax breakdown clarification requested.
tickets.rootCauseNotes: 3-month intro coupon expired automatically on billing portal.
tickets.correctiveAction: Credit note of Rs. 500 issued against ledger. Revised invoice emailed.

tickets.subject: Cannot Access FBR Tax Portal and State Bank PRAL Websites
tickets.description: ISP recursive DNS failing to resolve epay.punjab.gov.pk and iris.fbr.gov.pk. Google DNS 8.8.8.8 works when configured manually.
tickets.rootCauseCategory: Local BIND9 DNS Cache Poisoning / Upstream Sync Failure
tickets.rootCauseNotes: DNS forwarder on 103.x.x.5 failed upstream zone transfer with PKNIC.
tickets.correctiveAction: Flushed BIND9 cache and added secondary upstream routing via PIE (Pakistan Internet Exchange).
tickets.feedbackComments: Resolved quickly within 4 hours. Websites accessible now.

timeline.action: DNS Cache Flushed & Upstream PIE Sync Verified

tickets.subject: Optical Network Terminal Power Supply Burnout during FESCO Surge
tickets.description: Industrial high voltage spike destroyed OLT SFP transceiver and indoor ONT power unit. Replacement delayed beyond 8-hour statutory PTA window.
tickets.rootCauseNotes: Severe power surge destroyed optical front-end. Specialized 10G SFP module was out of stock at district warehouse and sourced from Lahore hub.
tickets.correctiveAction: SFP module delivered via courier and installed with industrial online UPS isolator. Resolution took 11 hours (exceeding 8h SLA). Incident reported to PTA Zonal CPD.
tickets.feedbackComments: The delay in equipment replacement disrupted production shift. SLA breach logged.

timeline.notes: Flagged for PTA Regulatory Annual Inspection Audit
